predecessors.name: French Africa
predecessors.text: Tunisia, until 20 March 1956 under France: 'Tunisia achieved independence from France on 20 March 1956 with Habib Bourguiba as Prime Minister.'

ledger.x: 1956: Tunisia becomes independent from France under Habib Bourguiba.
1957: Tunisia is declared a republic with Bourguiba as first President.
1961: fighting over the French naval base at Bizerte begins.
15 October 1963: the French evacuate Bizerte and the base returns to Tunisia.

wars.name: Bizerte crisis
wars.outcome: Infobox 'French victory' in the fighting of July 1961, but France handed the Bizerte base to Tunisia on 15 October 1963.
